settings.hero_desc: A detailed scale replica of an SUV in a bold finish, mounted on a lit base under a clear case. The perfect gift for a car launch, a collector, or a branded showroom centrepiece - we build any vehicle to order.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your vehicle, colour, plate/branding and base
settings.s1_body: Whether it's a dream car, a new launch or a customer's own vehicle, we recreate it as a detailed scale model - body lines, wheels, glass and interior captured faithfully, finished in your chosen colour and mounted on a lit base under a clear case. A standout gift, collector's piece or showroom display.
settings.case_heading: Easy to Bring to an Exhibition
settings.case_body: Built as a replica of Dubai Civil Defence's own vehicle, they used this model to showcase their defence vehicle and eliminated the need to bring an actual car to the exhibition. Saving space and cost on their booth.
settings.case_quote: All the details of our vehicle were matched exactly, in a short time.
settings.prov_p: A scale replica turns a car people love into something they can keep forever - a launch celebrated, a milestone marked, a passion displayed. We build any make and model to order.
